how_pulled: curl -sL https://zenodo.org/api/records/4446043 and /6976622 (file listing); then one at a time with sleep 1: curl -sL -o zen4446043_airbnb_<city>_<days>.csv 'https://zenodo.org/records/4446043/files/<city>_<days>.csv?download=1' for city in barcelona paris london rome, days in weekdays weekends; curl -sL -o zen6976622_hotel_<city>_<days>.csv 'https://zenodo.org/records/6976622/files/<city>_<days>.csv?download=1' for city in barcelona paris london; curl -sL -o models_robust.py '.../4446043/files/models_robust.py?download=1'; curl -sL -o gyodi_covid_airbnb_hotels.pdf 'https://zenodo.org/records/5233198/files/Airbnb_Covid_19_Cities__final_-5.pdf?download=1'. Described with pandas.
full_dataset_size: Record 4446043: 20 CSVs + 1 .py, ~10.7 MB, 10 cities (amsterdam, athens, barcelona, berlin, budapest, lisbon, london, paris, rome, vienna) x weekdays/weekends, ~51k listing-offers. Record 6976622: 17 CSVs, ~4.7 MB, 9 cities (no rome; stockholm weekdays only) x weekdays/weekends, ~9k hotel-offers. Record 5233198: one 1.18 MB PDF. Record 8135170: one 14.5 MB PDF (not pulled).
description: Replication data from Gyodi & Nawaro, 'Determinants of Airbnb prices in European cities: a spatial econometrics approach' (Tourism Management 2021) and its companion hotel-price collection: listing-level Airbnb quote prices (EUR, 2 guests, 2 nights) and hotel-level median 2-person prices from Booking.com-style listings, for 10 European capitals in summer 2019, split weekday vs weekend, with room type, capacity, ratings, distance to centre/metro, and lat-lon. Grain is one row per listing-offer (Airbnb) or hotel-offer; it is a single cross-section, not a time series. For ABNB an analyst would use it as a pre-COVID EMEA price-level and Airbnb-vs-hotel spread anchor (by city, room type, weekday/weekend) to sanity-check the EMEA ADR decomposition and the Inside Airbnb quote-index basis, and the COVID PDF for 2018-2020 nine-city listing/price tables. Source: Zenodo, CC-BY-4.0 (COVID PDF CC-BY-NC-4.0).
issues: Cross-section only (one summer-2019 snapshot); Airbnb CSVs have no date field, dates inferred from the paper and hotel datecontrol. Airbnb prices are quotes, not realised ADR. Hotel record lacks Rome (Stockholm weekdays present instead) so the 4th paired city is missing; hotel weekend files for Barcelona/Paris contain only the Hotels segment. Licences: CC-BY-4.0 for both CSV records (fine); the COVID PDF is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial, attribution needed if quoted). Underlying data were scraped from airbnb.com/booking.com by the authors in 2019 (tos flag on the job card refers to that provenance, not to anything run here). Zenodo rate-limits bots: fetch sequentially.
